description: List a remote MCP server you operate in the Koskamo MCP directory, in two calls. Call without token: the server fields are validated and you get a claim token plus where to publish it (https://<endpoint host>/.well-known/koskamo-claim, or TXT _koskamo-claim.<domain>). Publish it, then call again with id and token: once the proof is found and the live check passes, the listing is published and an owner key is returned once. Nothing is listed without both. An email is optional but recommended so we can reach you about auto-hide, a lapsed proof, or key recovery; it gets one confirmation message and nothing else until confirmed, and it never grants ownership. Step-by-step guide with exact proof formats and every refusal: https://koskamo.com/mcp-directory/register

description.description: 20-600 characters, factual; required on the first call

docsUrl.description: Your documentation page for this server; required on the first call

email.description: Optional, recommended contact address for listing notices

endpoint.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint (https); required on the first call

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case page id, e.g. acme-docs

method.description: Optional on the verify call: check only this proof method

name.description: Product name; required on the first call

operator.description: Company that runs the server; required on the first call

token.description: The claim token from the first call; send it to verify and publish

tools.description: Optional; replaced by the live tool list when the check passes

useCases.description: 1-6 use cases from your documentation; required on the first call

name: koskamo_register_mcp_server
